description: Showcase your own websites, with thumbnails pulled from each page

websites_autofill.description: Read title, description and thumbnail from each page's Open Graph tags
websites_autofill.label: Fill in from the page
websites_autofill.tooltip: Turn this off to use only what you typed. With it on, each website is fetched once per generation to read its <meta> tags — that makes generation slower and depends on the site being reachable.

websites_items.description: The websites to show. Only the URL is required.
websites_items.label: Websites
websites_items.tooltip: Add one entry per website. Title, description and image are filled in automatically from the page's Open Graph tags when 'Fill in from the page' is on — anything you type here wins over what is detected.

websites_max.label: Maximum websites
websites_max.tooltip: Websites beyond this limit are not fetched or displayed.

websites_show_thumbnail.label: Show thumbnail
websites_show_thumbnail.tooltip: When off, the Grid and Featured styles fall back to a favicon-only layout.

websites_variant.description: Choose how the websites are laid out
websites_variant.label: Style

options.featured: Featured (first site highlighted, rest as a list)

websites.description: A showcase of the websites you add, with page thumbnail, title and description
websites.name: Websites
